title: Elegant High-Low Sleeveless Empire Waist Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Introducing our Elegant High-Low Sleeveless Empire Waist Bridesmaid Dress, a stunning addition to any formal occasion. The effortlessly elegant high-low hemline adds a touch of sophistication to this classic design. Whether you're attending a wedding, prom, or other special event, this dress is sure to turn heads. Purchase it now and make a statement.

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Knee length/High-low.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, without lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises Polyester.


Stretch: Fabric is High stretch.
